$comment: Instance-pack recipe (plans/131 WP-D) - what leaves the building when scripts/build-instance-pack.ts cuts the distributable suse-brand .lolly file. The BRAND owns this list. Families are asset-id prefixes, not path globs, so a future asset in an excluded family stays excluded. Every asset id in catalog/assets/index.json must match exactly one of the two lists - the build fails on an unclassified family rather than guessing. Tool-local assets named in reuseCommunityToolAssets stay out of the pack only while their SUSE and community copies are byte-identical; the configured instance supplies them. The excluded media (photos, campaign, headshots, PremiumBeat music) stays on Brandfolder / the future id.suse.com instance; the build script additionally hard-refuses audio in any included family (the PremiumBeat rule is load-bearing, see the licence NOTICE).
name: SUSE Brand
